title: GGML Machine Learning Backend
summary: This module is the core GGML implementation, providing efficient machine learning operations by managing hardware backends, tensor computation, model quantization, and GGUF file persistence.

nodes.label: Discover Backends
nodes.title: Discover Available Backends
nodes.description: Identifies and registers various GGML hardware backends (CPU, GPU) available on the system.

nodes.label: Initialize Best Backend
nodes.title: Initialize Best Backend
nodes.description: Selects and initializes the most performant available hardware backend for computation, prioritizing GPUs.

nodes.label: Schedule Graph Execution
nodes.title: Orchestrate Graph Execution
nodes.description: Manages the execution of computation graphs across selected hardware backends, handling task distribution and synchronization.

nodes.label: Manage Graph Memory
nodes.title: Manage Graph Memory Allocation
nodes.description: Creates and manages memory allocators specifically for computation graphs, reserving and allocating tensor memory efficiently.

nodes.label: Transfer Tensor Data
nodes.title: Cross-Backend Data Transfer
nodes.description: Facilitates asynchronous and synchronous copying of tensor data between different hardware backends (e.g., CPU to GPU).

nodes.label: Execute CPU Operations
nodes.title: CPU-Optimized Tensor Operations
nodes.description: Performs core tensor computations (e.g., matrix multiplications, vector dot products) highly optimized for CPU architectures.

nodes.label: Execute GPU Operations
nodes.title: GPU-Accelerated Tensor Operations
nodes.description: Leverages GPU backends (Metal, Vulkan, BLAS) to accelerate tensor computations, offloading intensive tasks from the CPU.

nodes.label: Optimize Computation Graphs
nodes.title: Graph Optimization & Fusion
nodes.description: Analyzes and transforms computation graphs to improve execution efficiency on target hardware, including node fusion and reordering.

nodes.label: Build Backward Pass
nodes.title: Construct Backward Graph
nodes.description: Generates the computational graph required for backpropagation, enabling gradient calculation for model training.

nodes.label: Quantize Tensor Data
nodes.title: Tensor Data Quantization
nodes.description: Converts floating-point tensor data into various lower-precision integer formats to reduce memory footprint and improve inference speed.

nodes.label: Manage GGUF Files
nodes.title: GGUF Model File Management
nodes.description: Handles the reading, writing, and manipulation of GGUF (GGML Universal Format) files for persistent storage of models and metadata.

nodes.label: Allocate & Manage Buffers
nodes.title: Memory Buffer Allocation
nodes.description: Manages the allocation, deallocation, and usage of memory buffers for tensors and GGML contexts across different backends.

nodes.label: Convert Data Types
nodes.title: Floating-Point Type Conversion
nodes.description: Provides utilities for converting between different floating-point data types, such as FP32 to FP16, for compatibility and efficiency.

nodes.label: Query System Resources
nodes.title: System Resource Information
nodes.description: Retrieves system-level information, including available device memory and CPU properties, to inform backend operations.

nodes.label: Provide Debugging Tools
nodes.title: Graph Debugging & Verification
nodes.description: Offers utilities for visualizing computation graphs (DOT format) and comparing results across different backends for verification.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Model Fitting
nodes.title: Model Training & Optimization
nodes.description: Manages the overall process of fitting models to data, including iterative optimization steps and progress reporting.

nodes.label: LLM Runtime Core
nodes.title: Higher-Level LLM Runtime
nodes.description: The main LLM runtime that utilizes the GGML backend for model inference, training, and data processing.

nodes.label: Operating System
nodes.title: Underlying OS Services
nodes.description: Provides fundamental services like file I/O, memory management, and system information to the GGML backend.

groups.label: Backend Orchestration
groups.title: Hardware Backend Management
groups.description: Manages the discovery, initialization, and scheduling of computation graphs across various hardware backends (CPU, GPU), ensuring efficient resource utilization.

groups.label: Tensor Computation
groups.title: Core Tensor Operations & Optimization
groups.description: Executes fundamental tensor operations, leveraging both CPU and GPU acceleration, and optimizes computation graphs for improved performance and gradient calculation.

groups.label: Data & Model Lifecycle
groups.title: Data Handling & Model Persistence
groups.description: Manages the lifecycle of model data, including quantization for efficiency, handling GGUF file format for storage, and allocating/managing memory buffers.

groups.label: System & Diagnostics
groups.title: System Integration & Debugging
groups.description: Provides utilities for querying system resources, debugging computation graphs, and orchestrating the overall model training and fitting process.
